subject: Re: MAP - Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tools) + owners
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mark Jensen <mark.jensen@greenleafmed.com>, Jessica Torres <jessica.torres@greenleafmed.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com, rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP kickoff: integration build plan

Hi Mark / Jessica —

Thanks again for the 30-min demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

Summary of needs you called out:
- SDK integration into your ingestion pipeline (Java backend)
- Real-time streaming for clinician chat interactions (low latency)
- Tool calling for scheduled lookups to your patient DB (secure service-to-service)
- Structured outputs for downstream analytics (JSON schema)

I've attached an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP_Greenleaf_v2.pdf) and a proposed Integration Build Plan spreadsheet that breaks the milestone into owners, deliverables, and dependencies. Highlights below:

Proposed MAP milestone (Integration build plan)
- Milestone: SDK integration + streaming + tool-calls + structured outputs (MVP)
- Target close: 2026-09-24 (goal: pilot in staging)
- Redwood owners: Marissa (account lead), Dev Patel (integration engineer), Rachel Kim (platform PM)
- Greenleaf owners: Mark Jensen (platform lead), Jessica Torres (engineering manager)
- Dependencies: API access to sandbox DB, auth (mutual TLS), network egress rules for sandbox environment, final acceptance tests

Next steps
1) You confirm owners and target close (reply) — Mark/Jessica
2) Greenleaf shares sandbox access details & network contacts (by 2026-07-19)
3) Redwood schedules 3 kickoff working sessions (SDK, streaming, tools) — I'll send calendar invites once owners confirmed
4) Dev and Rachel will produce a 2-week sprint plan and initial test matrix by 2026-07-23

Attachments: MAP_Greenleaf_v2.pdf, Integration_Build_Plan.xlsx (see milestone tab)

If that looks good I’ll update the MAP and lock in the kickoff times.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Mark Jensen <mark.jensen@greenleafmed.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jessica Torres <jessica.torres@greenleafmed.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP kickoff: integration build plan

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap.

We (Greenleaf) confirm owners: myself (Mark) as platform lead and Jessica as eng manager. A couple of notes from our side:
- Sandbox: we'll provision a read-only sandbox DB and send connection details to Dev and Rachel by EOD 2026-07-18.
- Network: our infra team requires an IP allowlist and will need the Redwood egress IPs (I assume you have a published list?).
- Compliance: for tool-calling to access PHI-backed records we need to validate your KMS/HSM posture and SOC2 evidence — I can loop in security if needed.

Target close looks fine but can we slide pilot date to 2026-09-30 to give us two additional weeks for acceptance testing?

Confirming we'll review the MAP and the build plan after we receive the sandbox details.

—Mark
Platform Lead, Greenleaf Medical
mark.jensen@greenleafmed.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mark Jensen <mark.jensen@greenleafmed.com>, Jessica Torres <jessica.torres@greenleafmed.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com, rachel.kim@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP + detailed milestone owners (per your ask)

Mark / Jessica —

Thanks — updated the dates in the attached MAP (MAP_Greenleaf_v2.pdf) to reflect a pilot target of 2026-09-30. I also expanded the Integration_Build_Plan.xlsx to include per-milestone owners and acceptance criteria. Summary of milestone owners below (copied into the sheet):

Integration Build Plan (milestone breakdown & owners)
1) SDK integration (Java) — Owner: Dev Patel (dev_patel@redwood.com)
   - Deliverables: SDK package, example integration repo, OAuth2 + mTLS integration guide
   - Acceptance: SDK runs on Greenleaf staging ingestion with sample payloads, unit tests pass
   - Dependencies: Greenleaf provides sandbox DB creds; allowlist of egress IPs
2) Real-time streaming (clinician chat) — Owner: Rachel Kim (rachel.kim@redwood.com)
   - Deliverables: streaming API endpoint, sample client, backpressure guidance, latency SLO doc
   - Acceptance: median p90 latency < 200ms in staging under simulated traffic (20tps)
   - Dependencies: staging network throughput; TLS cert exchange
3) Tool calling (secure lookups) — Owner: Neha Kapoor (neha_kapoor@redwood.com)
   - Deliverables: tool-calling adapter, auth integration with Greenleaf service account, recorded audit events
   - Acceptance: successful secure lookup flow with masked PHI in logs; verified audit trail
   - Dependencies: service account + KMS token exchange, SOC2 evidence for key management
4) Structured outputs (JSON schema) — Owner: Mark Jensen (Greenleaf) + Dev Patel (integration)
   - Deliverables: JSON output schema, mapping doc, parser examples
   - Acceptance: downstream analytics team consumes sample outputs without manual transforms
   - Dependencies: final schema sign-off from Greenleaf analytics

Risks & mitigations
- Auth/KMS: heavy dependency on Greenleaf security docs. Proposed mitigation: we run a focused security sync week of 2026-07-26.
- Network egress: if allowlist delays, we can use a short-term tunneling approach for initial testing (requires infra signoff).

Action items I'm tracking
- Marissa: update MAP and push final v2 to Drive — done (see link)
- Dev: draft SDK roadmap and sample repo by 2026-07-23
- Rachel: schedule streaming perf test and share test harness by 2026-07-27
- Neha: gather KMS/SOC2 requirements and propose checklist by 2026-07-21

Please reply with any adjustments to owners or acceptance criteria. If that looks good I'll send invites for the kickoff sessions and the security sync.

Best,
Marissa

From: dev_patel@redwood.com
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, rachel.kim@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP + detailed milestone owners (per your ask)

Putting in writing my plan for the SDK integration work (high level):

Week 1 (2026-07-20 to 2026-07-24)
- Initialize example Java repo, basic auth flows (OAuth2 + mTLS), and build CI pipeline.
- Request: Mark/Jessica please share sandbox DB connection string + allowlist target for Redwood egress by 7/19 so I can wire samples.

Week 2 (2026-07-27 to 2026-07-31)
- Implement streaming client example, implement token refresh flow, add unit tests.
- Start basic perf runs locally and share initial numbers with Rachel.

Deliverables by 2026-07-31:
- public SDK artifact (Maven coordinates), example repo, integration guide draft

I'll create the repo today and share links. If Greenleaf needs stricter security handling for artifacts we can publish a private Maven feed.

Tagging Neha for KMS flow details and Rachel for streaming perf coordination.

Thanks,
Dev
Senior Integration Engineer, Redwood
